event_chain.summary: Employee credentials used on KYC vendor dashboard

summary: In October 2024 attackers phished a Transak employee, took over the employee's laptop and used the compromised credentials to log in to a third-party KYC vendor's dashboard, accessing names, dates of birth, selfies and passport and other ID documents of 92,554 users (about 1.4% of Transak's user base). The Stormous ransomware gang claimed responsibility. Transak, a fiat-to-crypto payment gateway, said no funds, passwords, card details or SSNs were affected and notified regulators.
